name: How messy and disruptive is cabinet refinishing if I still need to live in my San Diego house?

mainEntity.name: How messy and disruptive is cabinet refinishing if I still need to live in my San Diego house?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should expect dust, odor, noise, temporary access limits, and a period when doors or drawers are removed. Context: Good containment and off-site or separated door work can reduce disruption, but a working kitchen may not remain fully usable. The extent depends on the number of cabinets, coating products, ventilation, and repairs. Key factors: - Remove food, dishes, appliances, and fragile items near the work area. - Arrange a temporary meal area and protect nearby rooms. - Keep children and pets away from wet coatings and equipment. Practical guidance: Ask how the contractor will isolate sanding, manage overspray, ventilate, and secure removed doors. Confirm daily cleanup expectations and where hardware will be stored. Elite Remodeling & Design can coordinate cabinet work with other kitchen construction so tasks are sequenced rather than repeated.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect some dust, odor, noise, reduced kitchen access, and temporarily removed doors or drawers. Before work begins, clear cabinets, set up a temporary food area, protect nearby rooms, and ask how sanding, ventilation, hardware, and daily cleanup will be handled.
